text:
Mina P.: Hey all  first week on Integrations. Blocked on observability: need Grafana access to integr-main (prod) and integr-staging (staging), Datadog synthetics so I can run a quick smoke check during deploys, and Sentry project access for integrations-prod. Email mina.p@redwood.ai. Also want playlist access for oncall. Who's the fastest contact?
Jules (DevEx): Welcome Mina! :wave: Usual flow: Okta groups grant most view perms. Add observability-viewers and observability-eu for EU dashboards. Playlists are separate — request grafana:playlist-view or we can add you directly. For Sentry we add you to the project and link your GitHub. If any group missing file an identity request at https://go.redwood/identity-requests and paste the ID here.
Mina P.: I see observability-viewers but not observability-eu. Filed REQ-216900 with reason "multi-region access for integration tests".
infra-bot: Automated: Datadog invite queued for mina.p@redwood.ai (expires in 48h). Invite ref: 1865432100-INV. Track at https://idp.redwood/invites/1865432100
Nina (Platform): Mina  which org ids do you need? We have separate tenants for NA and EU. Also note: Datadog synthetic checks that hit external domains require a quick security form.
Mina P.: Need redwood-na-integrations and redwood-eu-integrations. Domains: stg-integrations.redwood.ai and integrations.redwood.ai. Plan to run a short synthetic during deploy window.
security-bot: Policy reminder: cross-region synthetics require security signoff. Please submit the form at https://go.redwood/sec-tests with target URLs and expected traffic.
Mina P.: Submitted security form SEC-1177 with details.
Jules (DevEx): If you want immediate playlist access I can add you to /playlists/integrations-oncall now. For cross-tenant dashboard links we typically use the orgId param in Grafana URLs; platform must grant cross-tenant viewer if the dashboards live in different orgs.
Mina P.: REQ-216900 got manager approval. Okta still shows observability-eu pending.
Nina (Platform): Provisioning started. I granted cross-tenant viewer for your account and added observability-eu. Also enabled synthetic-run permission scoped to the window 2024-09-02T14:00Z-2024-09-02T16:00Z.
infra-bot: Datadog invite accepted for mina.p@redwood.ai.
Mina P.: I can now see integr-main and integr-staging dashboards. How do I pin a cross-org dashboard to my sidebar?
Maya (Eng): Star the dashboard to favorite it. If the dashboard is in another org you can include orgId in the URL and create a browser bookmark. We also maintain playlist bookmarks if you want it in Grafana's playlist sidebar.
Jules (DevEx): Added Mina to /playlists/integrations-oncall and shared a short KB: https://kb.redwood/observability/cross-tenant-links. Scheduled a 15m walkthrough at 15:30 UTC.
Mina P.: Walkthrough accepted. Sentry invite arrived and I can see release-health for integrations-prod. Ran a synthetic in the approved window and the check passed. Thanks everyone :party_parrot:
